text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It’s the fastest way to surface real issues without slowing anyone down. The trade-off is delayed feedback on older PRs, but catching fresh mistakes now beats waiting for a random sample.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks normalizing noise in reviews, training reviewers to ignore PR-Agent output over time. A better alternative is running it on a random sample of merged PRs to catch systemic issues without cluttering active reviews. Settle this by measuring reviewer response rates to PR-Agent comments in both modes over two weeks.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first—this gives immediate feedback on active reviews while avoiding noise in open PRs. Compare reviewer response rates between this and a random sample of closed PRs to confirm the faster method doesn’t sacrifice quality.

name: Sprocket

name: Ratchet
text:
